blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Budget and Management (DBM) has yet to see any sign of a reenacted budget for 2027, amid concerns that the ongoing impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte could delay legislative deliberations. “We’re working closely with Congress to ensure that the process keeps moving forward. We haven’t seen any signs of that (reenacted budget) so far,” DBM Acting Secretary Kim Robert De Leon told reporters on the sidelines of the 58th Annual Financial Executives Institute of the Philippines Conference.
